subject: Acme Health - SOC 2 scope and evidence follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Price <e.price@acmehealth.com>, Olivia Zhang <olivia.zhang@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-29T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Acme Health - SOC 2 scope and evidence follow-up

Hi Olivia / Ethan,

Thanks again for the call earlier — appreciated the time. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment on scope and timelines: 

Summary of pain points / goals we captured
- Compliance: Acme is preparing for SOC 2 Type II; you're collecting evidence for audit and want clarity on Redwood's controls and artifacts.
- Logging & retention: need consolidated audit logs (admin console, API access, system events) shipped to your SIEM; retention policy configurable to meet regulated retention (7+ years).
- Data residency & DPA: US-only residency requirement for PHI-proximate workloads; DPA redlines required by Legal.
- Pen test / vuln evidence: need 3rd-party pen test summary and remediation timeline.
- Deployment model & SLA: evaluating Dedicated or Private for isolation and predictable latencies.

What Redwood will provide / next steps
1) Questionnaire & evidence checklist: attached acme_soc2_questionnaire.xlsx and requested_evidence_list.pdf — please use these to map the items you need for your audit.
2) SOC 2 report: we have a SOC 2 Type II report for FY2025; we can share under NDA and via a secure link.
3) Pen test summary: we ran a 3rd-party pen test in Q2 2026; summary attached (see separate file we will share).
4) DPA: attaching our current DPA (redwood_dpa_v3.pdf). If you have specific redlines, send them to security@acmehealth.com and cc me.
5) Technical deep-dive: Vivek to run a 60-minute session focused on audit logs, retention settings, KMS integration, and SIEM export. Proposed window: Fri Jul 2, 10:00 AM PT — please confirm availability.

Target timeline
- Internal intake / mapping: by Jul 10 (Acme maps checklist against existing evidence)
- Technical deep-dive: Jul 2 (confirm)
- Evidence delivery: aim to provide the bulk of requested artifacts by Jul 15

Attachments: acme_soc2_questionnaire.xlsx (XLSX), requested_evidence_list.pdf (PDF)

If I missed anything from the call, flag it and I’ll update. Otherwise, can we confirm Jul 2 for the technical session?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Olivia Zhang <olivia.zhang@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Price <e.price@acmehealth.com>, security@acmehealth.com
Date: 2026-06-29T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acme Health - SOC 2 scope and evidence follow-up

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from the Acme security team: 

1) SOC 2 report: can you confirm the report period (start / end dates) and whether you provide a bridge letter if the report is older than 12 months? We'll need the report and any management response sections relevant to availability and confidentiality.

2) Pen test: please confirm the scope (external only, internal network, application layer) and whether remediation tickets are tracked publicly or via a client-facing summary. A redacted pen test report or executive summary is fine.

3) Logs: we need admin console changes, API access logs (per-token or per-key), and system/service events. Can logs be forwarded to our Splunk instance (we'll provide ingestion endpoint)?

4) DPA: please send your DPA via DocuSign; our legal team will prepare redlines.

Timing: Jul 15 for evidence is preferable for our audit timeline. If Jul 2 works for the technical deep-dive, our security lead (security@acmehealth.com) will join; otherwise propose Jul 6.

Thanks — Olivia
Olivia Zhang
Director, Information Security
Acme Health
olivia.zhang@acmehealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Zhang <olivia.zhang@acmehealth.com>, Ethan Price <e.price@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-30T08:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acme Health - SOC 2 scope and evidence follow-up

Hi Olivia — great questions, answers below and next artifacts attached.

- SOC 2: Type II report covers period 2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30. We can provide the full report under NDA and will include a management response summary. If you need a bridge letter, we can generate that (standard practice).

- Pen test: Q2 2026 engagement covered external and application-layer tests; third-party vendor was RedTest Security. We are attaching a redacted executive summary (redwood_pen_test_summary.pdf) that includes scope, high/medium findings, and current remediation status.

- Logs: Redwood supports streaming audit logs to customer endpoints (S3/Splunk/BigQuery). We can stream admin events, API access logs (per API key / per request), and system events. During the technical deep-dive Vivek will show the SIEM export config and example query patterns.

- DPA: attaching current DPA (redwood_dpa_v3.pdf). For DocuSign, here's the signing link: https://app.docusign.com/agree/REDWOOD-DPA-v3. Please share any redlines back to security@acmehealth.com.

Attachments included: acme_soc2_questionnaire.xlsx, requested_evidence_list.pdf, redwood_dpa_v3.pdf, redwood_pen_test_summary.pdf

Proposed deep-dive: Fri Jul 2, 10:00 AM PT — agenda: 1) log formats & SIEM export, 2) retention & legal holds, 3) KMS & encryption, 4) pen-test findings, 5) Q&A.

If Jul 2 conflicts, we can move to Jul 6; otherwise I’ll send a calendar invite and a short agenda.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Zhang <olivia.zhang@acmehealth.com>, Ethan Price <e.price@acmehealth.com>

Date: 2026-06-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acme Health - SOC 2 scope and evidence follow-up

Thanks — confirming I'll host the technical deep-dive on Fri Jul 2, 10:00 AM PT. Proposed attendees: Vivek (Redwood infra), Marissa (sales/compliance), Rishi (solutions lead), Olivia (InfoSec), Ethan (Engineering), Acme security@acmehealth.com.

Agenda high-level:
- Walkthrough of audit log events (admin/API/system) and sample payloads
- SIEM export options (S3 + Kinesis + Splunk HEC) and recommended retention settings
- KMS integration and encryption-at-rest details (customer-managed keys available on Private/Dedicated)
- Pen-test summary & remediation timelines
- Q&A / follow-up artifacts to deliver (SOC 2 report link, redacted pen-test PDF, DPA link)

I'll send a calendar invite with dial-in and a short doc with example queries. Looking forward to it.
